clients.name: ERP Next.js Frontend
clients.description: Confidential OIDC client for the shared Next.js app (auth-code + PKCE). Auth.js runs server-side and holds the secret; the browser never sees it. Regenerate the secret after first import.

clients.name: MMS Postman
clients.description: Public OAuth2 authorization-code client for local MMS API testing with PKCE.

clients.name: ERP Backend Services
clients.description: Confidential client for service-to-service calls (client credentials). Spring resource servers only validate JWTs; they do not need a client, but this enables machine-to-machine auth. Regenerate the secret after first import.
